text_block_list.text:
...I lost again. Even though winning was
absolutely
necessary.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Even though I needed to prove myself
worthy of
the Mejiro family name...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
How can I ever get through this? How
can I?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Relax and take some deep breaths.
Don't let this get the best of you!

text_block_list.text:
How can I ever get through this? How
can I?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Relax and take some deep breaths.
Don't let this get the best of you!

text_block_list.text:
...I feel a little better now. It seems my
shoulders
were overly tense.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I must learn to control my mindset as
well.
Goodness, I have so many
challenges to
overcome.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: All that matters is that you don't give up.

text_block_list.text: You're right. Truer words never said.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
...I'm very sorry. It was disgraceful of me
to
display such agitation.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
What you mean to say is that I must grit
my teeth
and produce better results
next time, yes?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry. I will never
back down
from a challenge. Next time,
I will win and elevate
the prestigious
Mejiro name!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I'm fine now. Let's continue our training
for
victory!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
